answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, reset on any identity-link attempt, no identity may audit its own recruit. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Work waits on the spiral until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the relic of the next round. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the raven of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
